fields.PRODUCT NAME: Brass Hanging Bell / Brass Temple Ghanti
fields.DESCRIPTION: This elegant Brass Hanging Bell is a traditional accessory for temples and pooja rooms, designed to create a divine and soothing sound during prayers. Crafted from premium quality brass, it comes with a sturdy chain for easy hanging on temple doors, mandirs, or home altars. The clear, melodious tone of the bell is believed to dispel negative energies and invite positivity into your space. Perfect for daily rituals, spiritual practices, or as a thoughtful gift for loved ones.
